change: Replace the example-free v3 instruction with an explicit shared-meaning outcome: interpret each instance jointly, preserve shared context and relationships while generalizing differences, constrain the title to every instance, and subordinate brevity to meaning. No examples. V5 stays untested.
hypothesis: The revised outcome definition may retain shared subject context without introducing restrictions unsupported by some instances. This tests the complete instruction rewrite, not which individual sentence or input position causes a change.
evaluation: Sea salt: preserve food-use context across bagels and risotto; no uniquely required title string.
Coffee: preserve coffee-bean preparation/generalization across grinding and roasting; do not presume home setting.
Weather: do not impose season or morning on masks that do not establish it; inspect actual shared subject, not full-note metadata.
Art: retain semantic art category; broad Art may be correct given the generic member.
Literature: respect generic Literature member alongside detailed audiobook criticisms.
Weekend wishes: retain well-wishing across Saturday and Sunday without restricting to one day, religion, or platform.
execution: Twelve fresh independent wrapper calls. One exact prompt per config and sterile process. No tools, web, inherited conversation, response schema, full-note context, target titles or review judgments in generation. No cached prior outputs, retry or best-of selection.
controls: Same six complete groups, mask order and semicolon-separated quoted fragments, wrapper hash, pinned CLI binary, dedicated subscription authentication, model and reasoning effort as prior v4 experiment. Neither vectors nor grouping change.
limitations: Development sample selected after known errors, one output per version per node, no causal attribution to an individual wording change and no general accuracy estimate.
review: Assistant inspects all raw outputs against masks. Existing TUI shows only genuinely uncertain candidate judgments by default with separate assistant comment, complete masks, and fresh empty user session. Full six-card artifact also preserved for optional inspection. Do not prefill user decisions.
costs: Uses existing subscription allowance only; no API key billing or rented resources.
